description: Deterministic PII detect-and-redact for untrusted text (tickets, chat logs, LLM prompts) before storage or model input. Finds email, phone, US SSN, credit card (Luhn), IP, IBAN (mod-97), US ABA routing, and secret prefixes (sk-, ghp_, AKIA…). Checksum-validated; no LLM/NER. Returns findings with offsets, placeholders, redacted copy and countsByType. Optional types= filter. POST JSON {text} max 32 KB (GET ?text= max 2,000). Errors: 400 bad input. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: POST /v1/text/pii-redact.
name: text_pii_redact
title: Deterministic PII redact (email/phone/SSN/card/IP/IBAN/routing/secrets)
